chunks: Whatever is in it from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-'Ala, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Musa ibn Sa'dan, from Abdullah ibn Abi Al-Qasim, from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-'Ala Al-Khaffaf, mawla of Banu Asad.

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ: A named transmitter from whom reports are narrated in this chain.
key_terms.الْخَفَّافِ: An identifying epithet of Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-'Ala.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: A supplicatory honorific meaning 'may Allah be pleased with him.'
key_terms.مَوْلَى بَنِي أَسَدٍ: Client/freedman affiliation indicating his social association with Banu Asad.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-'Ala in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-'Ala. It is a technical chain statement used in hadith transmission, identifying the intermediaries linking the compiler to the named narrator.
